column1: # Upstream files this engine's rules are read from.

# comes from one of these. They are quoted rather than linked because a link
# rots and a quote can be checked — but a quote only stays honest while the
# file it came from stays put, and lazer ships every week.
# `tools/check-upstream.sh` refetches each one and says which have moved.
# A changed file is not automatically a changed rule; it is a prompt to read
